units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:3">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 3</cite> <he>חותך בה את הס׳</he> he cuts the twigs (trims the trees) with it.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 9:13">Tosef. Nidd. IX, 13</cite> <he>יושב על גבי ס׳</he> sitting on boughs (in which there is a seat of uncleanness), v. <cite ref="O00908"><he>סְכָכָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: ceiling of twigs or matting, esp. the cover of the festive booth.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 17a:10">Succ. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>סְכָכָן ס׳ כשר הוא</he> their cover is a proper one (such as is prescribed for the Succah); <he>סְכָכָהּ ס׳ פסול הוא</he> its cover is an unfit one; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:2:6">Y. Maasr. V, 51ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>זרע בבית והעביר הס׳</he> if he planted in a covered space and (after the seed reached a certain stage) removed the ceiling; [strike out the following <he>וסיכך על גביו</he>].—Pl. <he>סְכָכִין</he>.
